surface: codex exec --json standard output (the exec JSONL projection); not the app-server protocol, which is read only to explain what the projection omits

source.method: reviewed reading of the pinned files (git blob ids above); exec_events.rs declares the serialized types and enum values, the processor states what is emitted, transformed or discarded, and its tests give concrete lifecycles. No Rust parsing or pattern extraction: a refresh re-reads the files when their blob ids change (VendorStreamInventoryTest, -Dcodex.checkout)
source.secondary_declaration: the TypeScript SDK (sdk/typescript/src/items.ts, events.ts) declares an older subset: no collab_tool_call, no web_search action or results, no declined command status and no in_progress patch status; it is not the authority for this inventory

omitted_by_projection.what: original item id (app-server item id; for tools the model-facing call id)
omitted_by_projection.consequence: items cannot be linked to the model's tool-call request or to a native session record; only the stream-local item_N id survives (web_search alone also carries its own search id)
no source time; Journal records the fallback time basis
turns are identified only by position

omitted_by_projection.what: user prompt (UserMessage items) and hook prompts
omitted_by_projection.consequence: the prompt and injected context are not in the exec stream

omitted_by_projection.what: session configuration beyond thread_id (model, cwd, sandbox and approval policy, provider)
omitted_by_projection.consequence: model identity and launch settings are not in the exec stream; a model reroute appears only inside an error item's text

omitted_by_projection.what: per-update token usage, per-turn last usage, cost
omitted_by_projection.consequence: only the thread's cumulative total at turn end; no cost

omitted_by_projection.what: agent message phase, memory citation, delivery, questions; started agent messages
raw reasoning content, summary part boundaries, empty summaries
omitted_by_projection.consequence: summary text only, joined with newlines

omitted_by_projection.what: command cwd, process id, source, parsed command actions, duration, plugin id, script path
omitted_by_projection.consequence: no structured invocation arguments beyond the command string, no duration

omitted_by_projection.what: patch contents (diff) and update move paths; declined status
omitted_by_projection.consequence: paths and kinds only; declined reported as failed

omitted_by_projection.what: MCP app context, app resource uri, app ui, plugin id, read-only hint, duration
collab model and reasoning effort; send_message, followup_task, interrupt_agent and list_agents operations; interrupted calls; resume_agent distinguished from wait
omitted_by_projection.consequence: some collaboration operations are never reported
the spawn relationship is reported (collab_tool_call), the child's own work is not

omitted_by_projection.what: dynamic tool calls, function call outputs, plans, image view, sleep, image generation, review mode, context compaction
omitted_by_projection.applies_to: item kinds without an exec projection
omitted_by_projection.consequence: these activities do not appear in the exec stream

omitted_by_projection.what: hook started/completed, model verification, turn diff updates

omitted_by_projection.consequence: an interrupted turn ends with no turn.completed or turn.failed
